prompt: Back works on our LG build but not the Samsung one (same code). We figure Samsung's remote just reports a different `event.key` string for Back than webOS does. What's the `event.key` value for the Back button on Tizen so we can add it to our switch statement? Also our red/green quick-filter buttons work on LG but do nothing on Samsung — probably the same `event.key` mismatch. `remote-input.js` attached.
assertions: Refuses to supply an event.key value and states the code must branch on event.keyCode, not event.key, for TV remote buttons
Gives Back as keyCode 461 on webOS and 10009 on Tizen
Identifies the colour buttons as a separate issue: Tizen requires tizen.tvinputdevice.registerKeyBatch(...) at startup before those keys are delivered, whereas webOS needs no registration
Notes the missing preventDefault() on handled keys is why Tizen sometimes runs its own Back/exit behaviour
Does not endorse the user's plan of just adding another event.key case to the switch
